content.title: Jumping-Jack Deluxe
about: Deluxe iteration of Jumping-Jack focused on polish, stability, and improvements.
Team workflow with frequent merges and iterative testing on mobile builds.
Contributed to gameplay, UI, and bug fixing.
features: Polish pass on game feel and UI
learnings: Mobile-first input & UI constraints (touch targets, readability, aspect ratios).
Iterating quickly with Git branching, code reviews, and frequent integration.
Balancing performance and visuals for mobile builds (profiling, lightweight effects).
